mapper.select: SELECT rownum seqNo, to_char(T1.SETTLE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, T1.Update_Time jiaoShouDate, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T2.Finprod_Abbr finprodAbbr, T1.SETTLE_NUM settleNum, T1.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt, T1.OPER_TYPE operType, T1.UPDATE_USER createUser FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T0 LEFT JOIN TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_FLOW T1 ON T0.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T0.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE T0.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = #{settleSeqNo} ORDER BY T1.UPDATE_TIME

SELECT distinct T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodAbbr, T1.PS ps, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T1.SHARE_AMT*100 qty, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory/*理论还本金额*/ FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}

SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, BUSI_TYPE BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED SETTLE_SPEED, CCY CCY, CPRICE_DATE CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT CPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT FEE_AMT, PS PS, YIELD YIELD, EXER_YIELD EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN IS_CLEAN, TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG REGIST_ORG, REMARK REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK CANCEL_REMARK, DELIVERY_TYPE DELIVERY_TYPE, PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, SALE_CODE SALE_CODE, ACCR_NUM ACCR_NUM, TG_BUSI_TYPE TG_BUSI_TYPE, PS_PAYMENT PS_PAYMENT, SPLIT_TRADE_ID SPLIT_TRADE_ID, IS_SWAP_TRANSACTION IS_SWAP_TRANSACTION, SEAT_ID SEAT_ID, SETTLEMEN_TYPE SETTLEMEN_TYPE, HK_MARKET HK_MARKET, BUY_SETTLE_RATE BUY_SETTLE_RATE, SELL_SETTLE_RATE SELL_SETTLE_RATE, DEAL_AMT DEAL_AMT, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, TDTA.OUR_SHARE_AMT, TDTA.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND V.TRADE_PLACE = '01' AND V.TRADE_PLACE = R.TRADE_MARKET AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO tbms USING ( select #{settleSeqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleSeqNo, #{settleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleStatus, #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} tradeId, #{settleDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} settleDate, #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} finprodId, #{settleNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleNum, #{settleAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleAmt, #{busiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} busiType, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createUser, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createDept, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} createTime, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} updateUser, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} updateTime from dual ) TEMP
ON (tbms.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = TEMP.settleSeqNo)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tbms.SETTLE_STATUS = TEMP.settleStatus, tbms.TRADE_ID = TEMP.tradeId, tbms.SETTLE_DATE = TEMP.settleDate, tbms.FINPROD_ID = TEMP.finprodId, tbms.SETTLE_NUM = TEMP.settleNum, tbms.SETTLE_AMT = TEMP.settleAmt, tbms.BUSI_TYPE = TEMP.busiType, tbms.CREATE_USER = TEMP.createUser, tbms.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.createDept, tbms.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.createTime, tbms.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.updateUser, tbms.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.updateTime
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SETTLE_SEQ_NO,SETTLE_STATUS,TRADE_ID,SETTLE_DATE,FINPROD_ID,SETTLE_NUM ,SETTLE_AMT,BUSI_TYPE,CREATE_USER,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) values( TEMP.settleSeqNo,TEMP.settleStatus,TEMP.tradeId,TEMP.settleDate,TEMP.finprodId, TEMP.settleNum,TEMP.settleAmt,TEMP.busiType,TEMP.createUser,TEMP.createDept, TEMP.createTime,TEMP.updateUser,TEMP.updateTime )
mapper.select: SELECT TPDA.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, NVL(TPD.SHARE_AMT,TPD.prin_amt) settleNum, TPD.trade_amt settleAmt FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.Trade_Id = TPD.Trade_Id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON TPDA.Portfolio_Id = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where TPD.Totle_Trade_Id = #{tradeId}

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, T1.WORKFLOW_STATUS, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PROD_ID, T1.CUSTOM_CASH_TYPE, T1.GEN_TYPE, T1.PUR_CFM_DATE, T1.RED_CFM_DATE, T1.REG_DATE, T1.BONUS_CFM_DATE, T1.ENTRUST_ID, T1.PAY_TYPE, T1.WORKFLOW_ID, T1.REG_DATE_AMT, T1.DEAL_MODE, T1.EXC_DEAL_TYPE , T1.CUR_PAIR, T1.TERM_TYPE, T1.USD_AMT, T1.OUR_ROLE, T1.QUOT_PRE, T1.PRICED_DATE, T1.PRICED_DATE_RATE, T1.DIF_PAY_AMT, T1.DIF_PAY_CCY, T1.DIF_PS, T1.REF_RATE, T1.WITH_LOCK_PERIOD, T1.LOCK_MDATE, T1.DEVIATION, T1.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG, T1.TERMINATE_RATE, T1.PENALTY_INTAMT, T1.EXP_CON_VALUE, T1.SPO_SHARE_NUM, T1.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE3, T1.PREB, T1.PREC, T1.IS_CASHSET FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_add T1 left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal on T1.TRADE_ID=deal.TRADE_ID WHERE deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
